resources.string: A firewall that lives on your phone
Warden uses Android\'s VPN slot to see each connection your apps make. It\'s a local VPN: your traffic never goes to a server of ours, because there isn\'t one.
No account, no analytics, no cloud. The only downloads are blocklists you choose, and you can switch those off.
Warden reads destinations, like graph.facebook.com. It never decrypts HTTPS, so your messages and passwords stay sealed.
Android asks once. Only one VPN app can run at a time, so Warden can\'t run alongside another VPN.
Android requires it while Warden runs. It shows what\'s been blocked and has a Stop button.
Some phones, including %1$s, stop background apps to save battery. In App info, open Battery and choose Unrestricted so protection doesn\'t quietly switch off.
